leadership.name: James Odhiambo
leadership.bio: James has directed over 40 films across Kenya, Tanzania, and South Africa. His work has screened at TIFF, Tribeca, and the Zanzibar International Film Festival.

leadership.name: Amina Wanjiku
leadership.bio: With 12 years in production management, Amina has overseen projects for Apple, Netflix, and the BBC. She keeps every production running — on time, on brief, on budget.

leadership.name: David Kimani
leadership.bio: David's eye for light and composition has defined the FOB visual language. He shoots on film and digital, and believes every frame should stand alone as a photograph.

ideas.title: The Grammar of Light: How Cinematography Shapes Emotional Truth
ideas.excerpt: Light is never neutral. Every choice — hard or soft, warm or cold, directional or diffuse — is an argument about how the world feels.
ideas.author: David Kimani

ideas.title: Brand Films vs. Advertising: Why the Distinction Matters More Than Ever
ideas.excerpt: As audiences grow more resistant to traditional ads, the brand film has become the most powerful tool in a marketer's arsenal — if done right.
ideas.author: Amina Wanjiku

ideas.title: On Pre-Production: The 90% of Filmmaking Nobody Talks About
ideas.excerpt: The best work is made before the camera rolls. A breakdown of how we approach prep on every project, from brief to shoot day.
ideas.author: James Odhiambo

ideas.title: Shooting Kenya: A Field Guide to East Africa's Most Cinematic Locations
ideas.excerpt: From the Rift Valley to the Nairobi CBD, a curated guide to the locations that define our visual identity.
ideas.author: David Kimani

ideas.title: "We Were Told African Stories Don't Travel." They Were Wrong.
ideas.excerpt: A conversation with a Nairobi-based director whose debut feature screened at three international festivals in 2024.
ideas.author: James Odhiambo

ideas.title: Sound Design Is Storytelling: Notes from Our Post-Production Suite
ideas.excerpt: The sounds you don't notice are the ones doing the most work.
ideas.author: Sarah Muthoni

ideas.title: What Streaming Has Done to the Documentary Form
ideas.excerpt: Netflix changed everything. Whether that's good or bad depends on what you value.
ideas.author: Amina Wanjiku

ideas.title: The Edit Is the Film: How We Approach Post-Production
ideas.excerpt: You don't find the film in post. You find the film you actually made.
ideas.author: Brian Otieno

ideas.title: The Rise of the African Creative Economy — and What It Means for Film
ideas.excerpt: Capital is moving. Audiences are growing. The infrastructure is being built. This is the moment.
ideas.author: James Odhiambo
